sources.brief:
Build a small public web page so office visitors can check the office opening hours.

The page must display the fixed text "Monday to Friday, 09:00-17:00" to every visitor.
Visitors must be able to read the opening hours without signing in.
This version contains only this static information page; it has no editing, booking, accounts or other product features.

The project has one team member, a Full-stack Developer. The Full-stack Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for implementing every product requirement and every implementation task. The Full-stack Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for testing every product requirement. The Full-stack Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for deploying the page.
There are no separate business-requirements approval, specification preparation, specification acceptance, user acceptance testing or release-decision activities in this small demo project.
